notablePrerequisites: Scythe of the Wretched attached to Flametongue Kavu.
description:
Cast Justice Strike by paying {W}{R}, causing Flametongue Kavu to deal damage to itself equal to its power.
Flametongue Kavu dies as a state-based action due to having zero or less toughness.
Scythe of the Wretched triggers, returning Flametongue Kavu from your graveyard to the battlefield and attaching itself to Flametongue Kavu.
Flametongue Kavu enters the battlefield, triggering itself and Impact Tremors.
Resolve the Impact Tremors trigger, dealing 1 damage to each opponent.
Resolve the Flametongue Kavu trigger, dealing 4 damage to itself.
Repeat from step 2.
